headline: Approved a license category change for Hill City at 299 Lunenburg Street and a premises change for The Cellar at 14 Mill Street.
summary: Mr. Lamoureux said customers had asked for drinks his current wine and malt license does not allow. Mr. Roy said the added space at The Cellar would mainly host live entertainment and has its own entrance and exit. A new wine and malt license for KP Market at 49 John Fitch Hwy was referred to a public hearing on November 16, 2026.
decisions: Approved the minutes of October 19, 2026 by roll call vote 3/0.
Referred the new off premise wine and malt beverage license application for KP Market Fitchburg LLC to a public hearing on November 16, 2026.
Approved the change of category for Nacoro Inc. DBA Hill City, 299 Lunenburg Street, by unanimous roll call vote 3/0.
Approved the change or alteration of premises for Ziggymill33, LLC / DBA The Cellar, 14 Mill Street, by unanimous roll call vote 3/0.

MINUTES OF MEETING 
A regular meeting of the Board of License Commissioners was held on Monday, November 2, 2026, called to 
order by Commissioner Sarefield at 6:00 PM. Commissioner Boscardin and Commissioner Fossa were present. 
FPD Liaison Lt. Christopher Bellofatto was present and Officer Michael Sevigny. City Clerk Joanna Bilotta 
and Assistant City Clerk Elizabeth McNiff were present.  
I. REVIEW AND APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF PRIOR MEETING(S) 
Regular Minutes of October 19, 2026.  
The regular of October 19, 2026 were approved by roll call vote 3/0.  
 
II. NEW APPLICATIONS 
Please note that the Commission may enter into Executive Session pursuant to G.L. c. 30A, sec. 21(a) 
(5) (Discussion of CORI results), if required during this portion of the agenda, and will return to 
regular session upon completion. 
 
Application for New Off Premise wine & Malt Beverage License  
KP Market Fitchburg LLC, 49 John Fitch Hwy  
(Refer to Public Hearing Monday, November 16, 2026) 
 
III. PUBLIC HEARING  
Application for Change of Category M.G.L. c. 138, § 12D (i.e., All Alcohol/Wine, Malt)  
Nacoro Inc. DBA Hill City, 299 Lunenburg Street  
Mr. Lamoureux was present at the meeting. Commissioner Sarefield asked him to explain the reason for 
the requested category change. Mr. Lamoureux stated that he was seeking the change because 
customers had been requesting alcoholic beverages that are not permitted under his current wine and 
malt license. 
Public Hearing opened 6:05 PM 
 
Ms. Mary-Jo Bohart, director of economic development spoke in favor.  
 
Public Hearing was closed at 6:10 PM
Page 2 
Application approved by unanimous roll call vote 3/0. 
Application for Amendment- Change or Alteration of Premises  
Ziggymill33, LLC / DBA The Cellar, 14 Mill Street 
Mr. Roy was present at the meeting. Commissioner Sarefield asked Mr. Roy to explain his plans for the 
additional space. Mr. Roy stated that the space would primarily be used to accommodate live 
entertainment at the establishment and noted that a stage is already in place. He also expressed interest 
in potentially offering food service in the area in the future. Mr. Roy further explained that the space 
has a separate entrance and exit, as well as a designated liquor storage closet. He stated that 
additional security cameras would be installed in the new area and that an additional security guard 
had also been added to their staff. 
Public Hearing opened 6:28 PM 
 
Ms. Mary-Jo Bohart, director of economic development spoke in favor.  
 
Public Hearing was closed at 6:30 PM 
 
Application approved by unanimous roll call vote 3/0. 
 
 
IV. CORRESPONDENCE  
 
 
V. NEW BUSINESS 
 
NEXT REGULAR MEETING 
 
 
Monday, November 16, 2026 
 
 
The meeting adjourned at 6:32 PM 
 
Respectfully submitted, 
 
Joanna Bilotta, City Clerk 
 
Approved:
